named_events.loss_description: ultimate loss estimate at 31 December 2020 is GBP 71.6m gross and GBP 21.7m net of reinsurance and including reinstatement premiums, primarily in its Accident and Health, Personal Accident Treaty and Credit Risk lines of business.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 5.3 million for the 2020 financial year, representing a 1.4% release of opening gross claims outstanding. The report does not provide specific gross causal factors for this movement. The net prior year movement was an adverse development of GBP 0.001 million. The syndicate also reported an ultimate net loss estimate of GBP 21.7 million for COVID-19 related claims in 2020, primarily affecting Accident & Health, Personal Accident Treaty, and Credit Risk lines of business.
raw_causal_phrases: Adverse movements of GBP 1.0 thousand (2019: GBP 18.5 million adverse) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development figure is taken from the 'Change in prior year provisions' row in Note 16, which is the most direct source. The narrative on page 21 states 'Adverse movements of GBP 1.0 thousand ... net of reinsurance', which refers to the net movement. The net movement in Note 16 is +GBP 0.001m (strengthening), which aligns with the narrative's 'adverse' description. However, the gross movement is a release. The LOB breakdown on page 21 for 'Claims' is for net movements and its total is inconsistent with other parts of the report, so it was not used for LOB movements. The calculated prior year development from the gross claims development triangle (Note 15) is +GBP 17.9m (strengthening), which significantly differs from the explicit gross figure of -GBP 5.299m (release) in Note 16. Note 16 is prioritized as the explicit reported figure.
